acceptance_criteria.text: Local historical replay drives AlpacaMarketStream through its normal connect, authenticate, subscribe, and frame handling, and observed market snapshots come from its production MarketStateAccumulator.
Local mode uses an in-memory transport that accepts only the fixed Alpaca market stream URL, cannot fall through to a real socket, performs no credential lookup, and makes no external network calls.
Replay remains bounded, resettable, virtual-clock controlled, and restart-restorable with stable cursor and normalized market state.
Injected transport and broker stream failures produce deterministic sanitized health/log/trace observations and allow bounded recovery.
Integration evidence covers frame decoding, malformed/duplicate/out-of-order rejection, recovery, replay state, and proof that no real WebSocket was opened.
